# controld_proxies (Data Source)

Lists the proxies traffic can be redirected through, usable as the `via` target of a `redirect` action on a `controld_custom_rule`, `controld_default_rule`, or `controld_rule_folder`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_proxies" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `countries` (Attributes List) The list of countries the proxies belong to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--countries))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `proxies` (Attributes List) The list of proxies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxies))

<a id="nestedatt--countries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `countries`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) The country code.
- `country_name` (String) The country name.


<a id="nestedatt--proxies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxies`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String) The city the proxy is located in.
- `country` (String) The country code the proxy is located in.
- `country_name` (String) The country name the proxy is located in.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the proxy is hidden from the default list.
- `lat` (Number) The proxy's latitude.
- `long` (Number) The proxy's longitude.
- `pk` (String) The proxy identifier, usable as `via` in a `redirect` action.
- `uid` (String) The proxy's unique identifier.
